title: Billing, plan changes, and cancellation
summary: When your subscription renews and what happens if you change or cancel your plan.
excerpts: Paid subscriptions renew monthly on your billing date. Workspace owners can find receipts, change the payment card, and view the next renewal date in Settings > Billing.
Plan upgrades take effect immediately with a prorated charge for the rest of the billing period. Downgrades start at the next renewal if your workspace fits the new seat and active project limits.

Workspace owners can cancel from Settings > Billing. The workspace stays available until the end of the current paid period. Cancellation stops renewal and does not automatically refund the current period. Export your data before access ends.
